description:
Configure the 'Electronics' category to sort products by 'Position' instead of the default. Then, manually arrange the following products to appear at the top of the list in this specific order:
1. Business Laptop Pro (SKU: LAPTOP-001) - Position 10
2. Smartphone Ultra (SKU: PHONE-001) - Position 20
3. Wireless Headphones (SKU: HEADPHONES-001) - Position 30

Navigate to Catalog > Categories, select the Electronics category, change the Display Settings to sort by Position, and set the explicit position numbers in the Products in Category tab. Save the category when finished.
